name: b04 — settlement state is derived: unpaid, partial, settled, over-collected
workings: outstanding = netPayable - credited - allocated, floored at zero; settled when outstanding reaches zero. On a netPayable of 10000: nothing received is unpaid with 10000 outstanding; 4000 allocated is partial with 10000 - 4000 = 6000 outstanding; 2000 credited plus 8000 allocated covers 10000 exactly and is settled; 11000 allocated over-collects by 1000 and is settled with outstanding floored at 0, never negative — the surplus lives on the receipt as change due or a banked advance (D2), not as a negative invoice.
